hello.text: Hi friend! I'm Mibo. Today we're playing with two sounds: the snake sound, and the tongue sound!

warmup.text: First, let's wake up our mouths! Big smile... now wiggle your tongue!

s_turn.text: Now you! Make a long snake sound.

s_intro.text: Here's the snake sound. Teeth together, big smile, and blow.

s_words.text: Let's put the snake sound in some words.

th_intro.text: Now the tongue sound! Your tongue peeks out between your teeth, and you blow.

th_words.text: Let's find the tongue sound in some words.

th_turn.text: Now you! Tongue out, and blow.

switch.text: Wow, you're a snake sound star! Now let's try a new sound.

bye.text: You did it! You practised the snake sound and the tongue sound. Here's a sticker for you!

fb_got_1.text: Yes! You did it! Super sound!

fb_tricky_1.text: Ooh, so close! Let's try again.

fb_tricky_3.text: Nice and slow. Let's try again!

welcome.text: Hello! I'm Mibo. First, grab your mom or dad so they can look at the instructions on the screen here. Then we can start learning fun new words!

welcomeRest.text: First, grab your mom or dad so they can look at the instructions on the screen here. Then we can start learning fun new words!

sh_hello.text: Hi friend! Today we're learning the quiet sound. It's the sound we make when a baby is sleeping!

sh_warmup.text: First, let's wake up our mouths! Make a big kiss face... now a big smile! Kiss... smile!

sh_intro.text: Here's the quiet sound. Push your lips out like a kiss, keep your teeth close, and blow.

sh_turn.text: Now you! Lips out, and make a long quiet sound.

sh_words.text: Let's put the quiet sound in some words.

sh_game.text: Now a listening game! I'll say two words. Tap the one with the quiet sound.

sh_pick_shoe.text: Sock... or shoe? Which one has the quiet sound?

sh_ans_shoe.text: Shoe! It starts with the quiet sound.

sh_pick_ship.text: Ship... or sun? Which one has the quiet sound?

sh_ans_ship.text: Ship! It starts with the quiet sound.

sh_end.text: The quiet sound can hide at the end of words too. Listen!

sh_bye.text: You did it! You made the quiet sound at the start and the end of words. Here's a sticker for you!

z_warmup.text: First, let's wake up our voices! Put your hand on your neck and hum. Can you feel it tickle?

z_hello.text: Hi friend! Today we're learning the buzzy bee sound!

z_turn.text: Now you! Make a long buzzy bee sound.

z_intro.text: Here's the buzzy sound. It's like the snake sound, but your voice turns on. Teeth together, smile, and buzz!

z_game.text: Now a listening game! I'll say two words. Tap the one with the buzzy sound.

z_ans_zebra.text: Zebra! It starts with the buzzy sound.

z_pick_zebra.text: Zebra... or fish? Which one has the buzzy sound?

z_pick_zip.text: Sip... or zip? Which one has the buzzy sound?

z_ans_zip.text: Zip! Your voice buzzes in zip.

z_bye.text: You did it! You buzzed like a busy bee. Here's a sticker for you!

z_end.text: The buzzy sound can hide at the end of words too. Listen!

rh_hello.text: Hi friend! It's rhyme time! Rhyming words sound the same at the end.

rh_game.text: Now a rhyme game! I'll say a word. Tap the picture that rhymes.

rh_pick_sock.text: What rhymes with sock? Clock... or fish?

rh_pick_mouse.text: What rhymes with mouse? Moon... or house?

rh_pick_cake.text: What rhymes with cake? Snake... or ball?

rh_pick_star.text: What rhymes with star? Sock... or car?

rh_bye.text: You did it! You're a rhyme time star. Here's a sticker for you!

tw_words.text: Let's load the word train! First chunk... next chunk...

tw_hello.text: Hi friend! Today we're playing Twisty Words! Some words are long and wiggly, and we take them one little chunk at a time.

tw_warmup.text: First, let's wake up our mouths! Stick your tongue out... wiggle it... now make the silliest face you can!

tw_intro.text: Here's the game. I say a word slowly, chunk by chunk, like a little train. Then we put the chunks together and say the whole word!

tw_pick_spaghetti.text: Which one is spaghetti? Elephant... or spaghetti?

tw_game.text: Now a listening game! I'll say a twisty word. Tap its picture!

tw_ans_spaghetti.text: Spaghetti! Long and wiggly and yummy!

tw_pick_butterfly.text: Which one is butterfly? Butterfly... or umbrella?

tw_finale.text: Now the longest, wiggliest word of all. Ready? Let's take it chunk by chunk!

tw_bye.text: You did it! You said the long, twisty words chunk by chunk. Here's a sticker for you!

word_hippopotamus.text: Hip... po... pot... a... mus! Hippopotamus!
